name: leveled_code_bench
description:
Rubric level-based code benchmark
	


	
		
		Introduction
	

This is a proof of concept for a coding benchmark, in which code problems would be synthetically generated, but the difficulty of the problems generated would be based on skill 
levels on a rubric which the synthetic generator AI would refer to. It also includes the idea of giving the LLM "inspiration" by randomly choosing from a list of algorithms and coding topics, to increase question diversity.

	
		
		Dataset creation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bennny674/leveled_code_bench.
general_score_metric: task_success_rate (unit-test pass rate), often reported as pass@1
reputation: Proof-of-concept dataset on Hugging Face for rubric-level synthetic code problem generation; limited adoption so far.
